notes: Pursued Whale, printed: 'When this creature enters, each opponent creates a 1/1 RED Pirate creature token with "This token can't block" and "Creatures you control attack each combat if able."' The Whale enters on your turn; the opponent gets the Pirate. On the opponent's turn you give your 1/1 Bear a +1/+1 counter and protection from red with Feat of Resistance (colour word 3 = R). The Pirate must attack (no DECLINE is offered); your Bear (2/2) blocks it (the step's spare decision words go to the Bear's unmapped block ask, whose first legal word is the Pirate). The red Pirate's 1 damage to the Bear is prevented (CR 702.16e) and the Pirate dies. A non-red token would mark 1 damage on the Bear.
